author: edwardhazell.com

title: I can’t move forward.
body:
So I downloaded the app because I saw it was recommended by some people on Reddit, and it started out pretty good. I love the layout and the ease of use and everything looks perfect for what I need.  
I loaded all my tasks and completed some, but when I next opened the app, to tick off a task, a full screen came up within the app saying “Never miss a habit again. Add widgets to your… “ and the app is frozen there. I cant close that screen, I cant move past it. I close the app and restart it but the same screen comes up preventing me from accessing my habits. The  “Never miss a habit again” screen is literally causing me to do just that. It’s rather frustrating. I get that it’s probably a little bug and I hope you can fix it because I really like this app.
author: pariah-fish

title: Awesome 👌👌
body: This app improved my productivity, as I can track my habits and set a timer at the same. The user interface is really helpful, and it is as simple as it gets. I recommend this if you're looking for something helpful and simple.✌️👏
